drafts.draft: One self-contained narrative hub for a completed four-wave defect program whose last wave is merged and whose close-out is deliberately unfinished. Open with the aggregate outcome and the two things still held back, then cover the program as a map rather than a plan with a status strip and the single authorization it ran under, the wave ordering as a release argument with an inline serial flow diagram and a comparison table of shape and baseline, per-wave outcomes as one comparable review-and-merge table followed by the distinguishing story of each wave, the convention evolution as a dated timeline of adopted rule sets plus a table of the three rules that changed outcomes, aggregate numbers as an evidence table with units and an explicit statement of the two figures the records do not support, and a follow-up ledger with owner, status and next action plus the trigger-bound minors and the human-gated items still open.
drafts.visualIntent: Editorial hub on the narrative path. One dominant serif title over a short framing statement, then deliberately varied section treatments rather than one repeated card: a two-column status strip, a bounded-scroll inline SVG flow diagram carrying the version baseline on each edge, three comparison tables with comparable columns, a dated timeline for rule adoption, GFM callouts for the human gate and the unresolved-claim disclosure, and a task list for what is still open. Every section carries its own cited source list.
